sourceWork: Buffy the Vampire Slayer — saison 7 (après le retrait de la puce de Spike, avant la Faux et l’amulette)
method: Manual actual native anatomical localization, nearest-neighbor source→cell mapping, at most2px local packed-cell refinement in same real palm/wrist; alpha>24 9x9 neighborhoods counted exactly. No art pixels changed.
